svg.title: AA demo: 1-servo illustrated breadboard
svg.desc: A four-AA NiMH holder, inline fuse, RCY connector, physical master switch, regulator, three WAGO power junctions, capacitor, headered Pico and MG90S servos with exact breadboard holes. No servo gate or battery sensing. Illustrations are not to scale.
svg.text: The AA demo · every part, every connection
1 servo · 4 rechargeable AA NiMH cells · continuously powered servo · no GP15 gate / no GP26 battery sensor
Assembly illustration, not to scale. Follow labels and hole addresses; check actual module silkscreen before soldering.

g.text: Follow the + / − moulded inside your holder.
Solder to labelled pads; EN unused.

svg.text: Number ports left to right as shown.
All 5 ports inside ONE block are connected.
This build uses one servo on Pico GP16.
P5V port 5 and GROUND B port 4 stay empty.
GP17 is unused. No extra resistor or wires.
Calibrate unloaded before pressing the switch.
External charger · no connection to this circuit
b30 → P5V.3 / a50 → PGND_B.2 / j35 → servo 1 S
Remove Pico and unplug servos for first voltage checks.
Black probe c50; red c30 ≈ 5 V; red c35 below 5.5 V.
Disconnect battery before reinserting the Pico. USB initially unplugged.
Only use the aa-demo firmware profile. No automatic low-battery cutoff.
Thick power wiring stays OFF the breadboard; crossing lines do not join.
AUTO-SWITCH / AA DEMO • Manufacturer-based illustrations; cosmetic details simplified. Connectivity checked, physical build not yet tested.
